governanceNotes: D1 batch 38 (2026-09-23): deferred. Negative screen recorded 2026-09-23: (i) zero-record outcome screening - targeted 'gigantism heart failure', 'gigantism cardiomyopathy', and 'gigantism diabetes mellitus outcome' queries return no gigantism-specific outcome records: hits resolve to adult acromegaly (PMID 38810595 human-feline acromegaly comparison documenting heart failure, ventricular hypertrophy, and diabetes mellitus in acromegaly; PMID 34795812 acromegaly treatment-outcome cohort with hypertension 39.3% and diabetes 28.6%), syndromic or genetic growth disorders with acromegaly-like features (PMID 30592149 Sotos-like overgrowth with cardiomyopathy, PMID 35713067 congenital syndrome with gigantism features and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, PMID 41332312 genetic-series, PMID 20301463 Carney-complex surveillance noting gigantism/acromegaly risk), or unrelated records (PMID 37215625 rheumatic mitral thrombus, PMID 33637859 machine-learning cardiomyopathy codes, PMID 33030620 nuclear hypertrophy in heart failure); (ii) the dedicated pediatric literature is surgical and molecular rather than outcome-quantifying - the Kumar 2026 pediatric-gigantism surgical series (PMID 42538445) reports cure rates by transsphenoidal technique with hypopituitarism and diabetes insipidus as POST-TREATMENT complications (treatment-mediated, reverse direction guard), and the molecular review (PMID 39904816) frames gigantism in children and acromegaly in adults as a shared growth-hormone/IGF-1 axis continuum without pediatric comorbidity quantification; a pediatric quality-of-life/comorbidity query returns zero records; (iii) duplicate-scope pathway ownership - the acromegaly identity (published) already carries the growth-hormone-excess systemic edges (hypertension, sleep-apnea) on its own adult evidence base, so authoring gigantism edges from pooled or acromegaly-derived literature would run a parallel pathway for one hormonal mechanism across two identities (the batch-22/27/33 class-family ban applied through the shared-driver lens: growth-hormone excess is the shared driver, life stage differs, but no GIGANTISM-SPECIFIC evidence separates the pathway); (iv) wrong-identity guard - pituitary-neoplasm (the somatotropinoma source) owns the chiasmal-compression visual-impairment edge, and its tumors are upstream causes of gigantism rather than outcomes. Reopening condition: a gigantism-specific cohort or series quantifying a catalog-fit secondary outcome with chronology, or a governance decision to merge gigantism with the acromegaly pathway under a single growth-hormane-excess identity.
